sessions.title: Index Card Theater Scene Cues
sessions.clubUse: Adult-led printable story club session for a library table, homeschool co-op, tutoring group, or classroom writing club.
sessions.groupMode: small groups at a writing table
sessions.kidDirection: Arrange three scene cue choices, then write the line that helps the next scene make sense.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Keep the cards face up, invite quiet pointing before writing, and make the read-back optional.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Save this scene-cue page in a folder so one cue can become a longer theater story later.

lines: An action cue I can add is ____________________.

A setting cue that makes the stage clearer is ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Club Page Finish
lines: The cue that connects my scenes best is ____________________.
One word I can revise for clarity is ____________________.
My final theater-club sentence is ____________________.

sessions.title: Margin Note Market Feedback Menu
sessions.clubUse: Adult-led printable story club session for a library table, homeschool co-op, tutoring group, or classroom writing club.
sessions.kidDirection: Turn a vague market note into a kind, specific revision task for a made-up writer.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Use sample notes only, keep all feedback about invented pages, and let each child choose one task to finish.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Save this feedback-menu page to use as a calm revision checklist for a future draft.

The next revision step should be ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Club Reflection
lines: The most useful feedback word on my page is ____________________.
One note I would choose for my own draft is ____________________.
My final market feedback line is ____________________.

sessions.title: Clue Label Tower Curator Cards
sessions.clubUse: Adult-led printable story club session for a library table, homeschool co-op, tutoring group, or classroom writing club.
sessions.kidDirection: Choose everyday-object clues and write short labels that tell readers what to notice first.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Offer harmless classroom or table objects as inspiration, then keep the final labels invented and brief.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Save this curator-card page so one label can become a short museum scene at home.

pageSections.heading: Curator Finish
lines: The next exhibit card should connect to ____________________.

My final tower museum line is ____________________.

sessions.title: Revision River Draft Ferry
sessions.clubUse: Adult-led printable story club session for a library table, homeschool co-op, tutoring group, or classroom writing club.
sessions.kidDirection: Move one scene stop, add one useful detail, and write a clearer ferry route sentence.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Frame revision as rearranging choices on a made-up ferry map, not judging a child's personal draft.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Save this ferry page as a take-home revision map for a future story scene.

sessions.title: Compass Craft Story Route
sessions.clubUse: Adult-led printable story club session for a library table, homeschool co-op, tutoring group, or classroom writing club.
sessions.kidDirection: Plan a beginning, middle, and finish route, then revise the turning point so the story path is easy to follow.
sessions.facilitatorNote: Keep route choices limited to three cards, ask one guiding question at a time, and let saving the page count as completion.
sessions.takeHomeLine: Save this route page to finish the first paragraph of a Compass Craft Academy story later.
materials: colored pencil for the chosen path
